issues: Integrity is fine. The diff changes one hyperparameter: WARMDOWN_RATIO goes from 0.5 to 0.3. It doesn't touch the evaluation call, the data, the prepare.py import line or the seed lines. It doesn't add a bug that would make the result meaningless.

I can't check the z value independently. The harness gives the incumbent mean (1.0831, n=2) but not the two individual runs or their spread, and there is only one candidate run, so there is nothing to estimate variance from. The reported z = -0.073 does have the right sign: the candidate (1.0836) is 0.0005 worse, since lower is better. It would also mean a spread of about 0.007, which is plausible.
The decision is consistent with the numbers. The candidate is slightly worse and well within noise, so rejecting it is reasonable.
